name: mothx-desktop
description: MothX desktop client (Electron ACP client + standalone renderer)

scripts.start: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime && npm run build && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dev:mac: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform darwin && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.yml --arch $(node -p process.arch)
scripts.dist:dev:win: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform win32 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dev:linux: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform darwin && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --arch $(node -p process.arch)
scripts.dist:win: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform win32 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: npm run version:set && npm run ensure:electron && npm run build:runtime -- --platform linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
